summary: SK Telecom Co., Ltd., a South Korean telecom, filed a Form 6-K disclosing board approval on June 29, 2026, to acquire 642 new shares of affiliate SK hynix NAND Product Solutions Corp. (SKHNPS) for approximately 397.1 billion Korean won (about $257 million). The stake after acquisition will be 0.62%. The purchase is for cash, intended to facilitate synergies with SKT's AI business, with a scheduled acquisition date of July 23, 2026. The transaction is a minority equity investment in a semiconductor affiliate, not a control acquisition. Watch for exchange-rate adjustments and completion timing.
